common.machineTranslated: Leli khasi lihunyutshwe ngomtshina, alikahlolwa ngumuntu okhuluma ulimi lolu.

footer.note: I-Golden Moments iletha izenzo ezilula zokwenza ndawonye ukuze lithokoze. Akusiso seluleko sezokwelapha, isivivinyo loba ukwelatshwa, njalo ayihloli, ayilinganisi loba ukukalela muntu amanqaku. Nxa ule mibuzo ngezeempilakahle, khuluma lodokotela. Esimweni esiphuthumayo, fonela u-999.

home.title: Imidlalo Lemisebenzi Yabaphila le-Dementia le-Alzheimer's | Golden Moments
home.description: Imidlalo yemifanekiso elula yokudlala ku-inthanethi mahala lemibono yezokwenza eyabantu abaphila le-dementia loba i-Alzheimer's labanakekeli babo. Akudingi ukubhalisa, asikho isikhathi esikhalayo loba amanqaku.
home.eyebrow: Mahala · Ayikho imikhankaso · Akudingi ukubhalisa · Asikho isikhathi esikhalayo loba amanqaku
home.h1: Imidlalo Lemicimbi Elula Eyabantu Abaphila le-Dementia
home.lede: Imidlalo yemifanekiso elula, izithombe ezaziwayo, lemicimbi yokuthokozisa ndawonye—ngesikhathi senu esilula.
home.heroApp: Kunjalo kule-app yamahala ye-iPhone, iPad le-Android, ehlanganisa izithombe zemuli yenu
home.gamesLede: Umdlalo ngamunye uthulile, ufanela abantu abadala njalo uqala masinya. Khethani owodwa, hlalanani eceleni, litshintshane ngokuthepha.

steps.title: Khethani into eyaziwayo
steps.text: Imifanekiso yenkomishi zetiye, izilimo, izifuyo lezikepe. Akudingeki ukubala loba ukufunda imithetho kuqala.

steps.title: Hlalani eceleni
steps.text: Myekele athephe. Xoxani ngemifanekiso leyo. Nxa ingahambelani kumelele ukuthepha okulandelayo kuphela.

steps.title: Yimisani nxa kusathokozisa
steps.text: Umdlalo owodwa ngumsebenzi opheleleyo. Isaziso esithi “Kwanele okwakhathesi” sihlala sikhona esikrinini.

home.stageLede: Umculo, imisebenzi yansuku zonke, ukukhumbula izikhathi zakudala lezikhathi zokuthula ezinelisayo, kuhlanganiswe ngendlela elula okwakhathesi.

stages.title: Isigaba sokuqala
stages.text: Qhubekani lisenza lokho akuthandayo, lilungisa kancane: izinto azithandayo, ukuhambahamba, imidlalo yamabala lokuhlela ndawonye.
stages.label: Imibono yesigaba sokuqala

stages.title: Isigaba esiphakathi
stages.text: Imisebenzi elula eyaziwayo ehlukaniswe ngezinyathelo: ukugoqa, ukuhlela izinto, umculo, imidlalo yemifanekiso lokuhambahamba okufitshane.
stages.label: Imibono yesigaba esiphakathi

stages.title: Isigaba sokucina
stages.text: Ukududuzeka lokuxhumana ngokubamba, ukuzwa lokubona: ukunakekela izandla, izingoma azithandayo, izithombe lokuhlala ndawonye.
stages.label: Imibono yesigaba sokucina

home.specificHtml: Lidinga into ethile na? Lingazama imisebenzi lemidlalo ye-Alzheimer's, imidlalo elula yenkumbulo, imibuzo elula loba amapuzzle.
home.approachLede: Imidlalo eminengi “yengqondo” igxile ekugijimeni, kumanqaku lasekusebenzeni ngokuqhubekayo. Kumuntu ophila le-dementia lokhu kungafana le-eksamu. Thina sakha okuphambene lalokho.

principles.title: Akukho ukuhluleka
principles.text: Akula wotshi, manqaku, zimpilo loba ukunqotshwa. Umfanekiso ongafaniyo ukumisa kancane, hatshi iphutha.

principles.title: Imifanekiso ihlala ibonakala
principles.text: Ukubona lokho okukhona kulokuzama ukukhumbula. Ukubhangqa kuqala kubonakala obala, ngakho akukho okumele kukhunjulwe.

principles.title: Okwabadala njalo okulesithunzi
principles.text: Amabala afudumeleyo, acacileyo lemifanekiso yempilo yangempela. Akula mifanekiso yopopayi loba ukukhuluma kwabantwana.

principles.title: Kuvikelekile ngokwemvelo
principles.text: Akula ma-akhawunti loba imikhankaso. Izithombe zenu aziphumi kudivayisi yenu.

guides.title: Ukudlala imidlalo ndawonye
guides.text: Ukuhlela, isivinini, lokuthi kungenziwani nxa umdlalo ungasathokozisi.

guides.title: Nxa besala ukwenza umsebenzi othile
guides.text: Izizathu ezijwayelekileyo zokwala, lendlela ezilula zokuzama futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.

guides.title: Ukuhlela ithebhulethi
guides.text: Amabala amakhulu, ukuphazamiseka okuncane lesikrini esisodwa esilula sasekhaya.

guides.title: Izenzo zokuphrinta zamahala
guides.text: Ukusesha amabala ngamabala amakhulu, amakhasi okufaka imibala, i-bingo lamakhadi okuxoxa.

home.researchText: Kambe i-dementia ingavikelwa na? Imidlalo yengqondo iyanceda na? Kuthiwani ngokuzila ukudla, ukudla okunempilo, ubuthongo lokuzwa? Izimpendulo ezicacileyo ezilezibonakaliso, kufaka lalapho ubufakazi bungaqinanga khona.
home.appText: I-app yamahala isebenza langaphandle kwe-inthanethi njalo ingasebenzisa izithombe zemuli ozikhethayo, ezilondolozwe kudivayisi yakho kuphela. Umklamo ofanayo othulileyo: izikwele ezine ezinkulu, asikho isikhathi esikhalayo, akula manqaku.

faq.q: Yiphi imidlalo emihle eyabantu abaphila le-dementia?
faq.a: Imidlalo emihle ilula, ijwayelekile futhi ayinakucindezela: izithombe ezinkulu zokufanisa, ukuhlela, izigcawu ezilula, ukuqedela izaga ezaziwayo, ukudweba, ibingo yezithombe namakhadi okuxoxa. Okukhethwa okuhle kakhulu yilokho umuntu akujabulelayo namuhla. Gwema izikhathi, amaphuzu nanoma yini efana nokuhlolwa.

Yebo. Yonke imidlalo nezinto ezingaphrintwa kuGolden Moments ayimahhala, ayidingi i-akhawunti, ukubhalisa noma ukulanda. Imidlalo isebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu ku-foni, kuthebulethi noma kukhompyutha.

faq.q: Ingabe imidlalo yengqondo ivimbela isifo sokukhohlwa?
faq.a: Akukho mdlalo okhonjiswe ukuthi uvimbela isifo sokukhohlwa, futhi iGolden Moments ayithi iyaselapha noma ivimbele lutho. Imidlalo yethu yokujabulisa nokuchitha isikhathi ndawonye. Isigaba sethu sempilo yengqondo sichaza ukuthi ucwaningo lukhombisa ni nokuthi alukhombisi.

faq.q: Ingabe lezi zimidlalo zifanele umuntu one-Alzheimer's?
faq.a: Yebo. I-Alzheimer's yisona sizathu esivame kakhulu sesifo sokukhohlwa, futhi imidlalo yenzelwe lona: izithombe ezinkulu ezihlala zibonakala, izinketho ezimbalwa, nokungabi nalutho okufanele ukukhumbula noma ukungakwenza kahle. Ukufanisa, ukuhlela nokuqedela izaga ezaziwayo kusekelwe olwazini umuntu alubambe isikhathi eside, hhayi ekufundeni okusha.

faq.q: Ingabe umuntu onesifo sokukhohlwa esesigabeni esiphezulu angazisebenzisa lezi zimsebenzi?
faq.a: Kaningi yebo, uma kukhona omunye umuntu eduze kwakhe. Qala ngoMdlalo Wokuthola Okufanayo Ngezithombe Ezimbili, Izithombe Ezimbili Ngamathayela Amane, ikhasi lokudweba noma ukuphefumula ngokuthula. Yenza kube mfushane, landela ukuthanda kwakhe, bese uyeka uma sewanele.

Lesi sayithi asinawo ama-akhawunti futhi asinazo izikhangiso. Sisebenzisa i-Google Analytics ukuqonda ukuthi yimaphi amakhasi avakashelwa. Izithombe ozikhethela Izithombe Ezimbili zibonakala kusiphequluli sakho kuphela futhi azilayelwa.

I-Golden Moments yiqembu elincane elenza imisebenzi yezithombe ethulile yabadala yemindeni nabanakekeli, ewebhusayithini nanjengohlelo lwe-app olumahhala. Asingabasebenzi bezempilo, futhi lutho lolu lapha akuyona iseluleko sezokwelapha.

playCta.title: Ulungele umdlalo othulile?
playCta.text: Izithombe ezinkulu, akukho sikhathi, akukho amaphuzu futhi akudingeki ubhalise lutho. Dlalani ndawonye kusiphequluli sakho.

appCta.title: Thatha lezi zimidlalo nawe
appCta.text: I-app ye-Golden Moments emahhala ye-iPhone, i-iPad kanye ne-Android: amathayela ezithombe amakhulu, imidlalo ngezithombe zomndeni wakho, namaphakheji ezithombe asebenza ngaphandle kwe-Wi‑Fi. Akukho i-akhawunti, izikhangiso, sikhathi noma amaphuzu.

activities.label: Imisebenzi
activities.title: Imisebenzi Yabantu Abanesifo Sokukhohlwa
activities.seo: Imisebenzi Yabantu Abanesifo Sokukhohlwa: Imibono Ngesigaba
activities.description: Imibono yemisebenzi yabantu abaphila nesifo sokukhohlwa kuzo zonke izigaba: umculo, ukukhumbula izikhathi zakudala, imisebenzi yansuku zonke, imizuzu yezinzwa, ubuciko, ngaphandle namaphrinta amahhala.
activities.lede: Umsebenzi onenjongo ulethe induduzo, injongo noma umzuzu wokuxhumana. Qala ngalokho umuntu ayekujabulela njalo, bese ulushintsha ngokwesikhathi samanje.

caregiving.label: Ukunakekela
caregiving.title: Iziqondiso Zokunakekela
caregiving.seo: Iziqondiso Zokunakekela Abanesifo Sokukhohlwa: Usizo Lwansuku Zonke
caregiving.description: Iziqondiso ezilula nezinomusa zabanakekeli babanesifo sokukhohlwa: ukudlala imidlalo ndawonye, ukuxhumana, ukwala, ukukhathazeka kwasekugcineni kosuku, amathebulethi, ukukhetha ama-app kanye nokuzinakekela.
caregiving.lede: Usizo oluhlelekile nolulula ngezikhathi zansuku zonke zokunakekela umuntu ophila nesifo sokukhohlwa, kuhlanganise nokuzinakekela wena ngokwakho.

brain-health.label: Impilo yengqondo
brain-health.title: Impilo Yengqondo: Okuthi Ucwaningo Lukusho
brain-health.seo: Impilo Yengqondo Nengozi Yesifo Sokukhohlwa: Okuthi Ucwaningo Lukusho
brain-health.description: Ingabe isifo sokukhohlwa singavinjelwa? Izincwadi ezithembekile nezinemithombo ezichaza izinto ezingabangela ingozi yesifo sokukhohlwa, imidlalo yengqondo, ukuzila ukudla, ukudla, ukuzivocavoca, ukulala, ukuzwa kanye nezimpawu zokuqala zokuxwayisa.
brain-health.lede: Yini ngempela ezikhonjiswa ucwaningo olukhulu mayelana nokuncishisa ingozi yesifo sokukhohlwa, ichazwe ngokusobala, kuhlanganise nalapho ubufakazi buthambile noma buxubene khona. Ulwazi jikelele, hhayi iseluleko sezokwelapha.

guide.sourcesNote: Sixhumanisa nezinhlangano nezifundo okuthembele kuzo lolu khasi. Ngayinye yahlolwa lapho kubuyekezwa ikhasi.

healthNotice.title: Ulwazi jikelele, hhayi iseluleko sezokwelapha
healthNotice.textHtml: Leli khasi lifingqa ucwaningo olushicilelwe ngemindeni. Alikwazi ukukutshela ukuthi yini elungele umuntu oyedwa. Khuluma nodokotela ngaphambi kokushintsha ukudla, ukuzivocavoca, ukulala, imithi noma izengezo. Uma kukhona ukudideka okuzumayo noma ezinye izinguquko ezizumayo, thola usizo lwezempilo masinyane. Funda isaziso sethu solwazi lwezempilo.

about.title: Umsebenzi Wokwabelana, Hhayi Ukuhlolwa Kwenkumbulo
about.description: Ngani imidlalo ye-Golden Moments ingenasikhathi, amaphuzu noma izinsuku zokulandelana, ngani izithombe zihlala zibonakala, nokuthi yini esiyoyisho noma singayisho mayelana nesifo sokukhohlwa.
about.lede: I-Golden Moments yenza imisebenzi yezithombe ethulile yabadala, umnakekeli kanye nomuntu ophila nesifo sokukhohlwa angayijabulela ndawonye.
about.bodyHtml:
Esikholelwa kakhulu

Injongo yomsebenzi ngumzuzu ngokwawo: ingxoxo, ukumomotheka, injabulo yokuhlanganisa izithombe ezimbili, noma nje ukuhlala eduze. Akusikho ukumlinganisa umuntu, ukumphelisa okwedlule noma ukufakazela lutho.

Izinhlelo eziningi zokuqeqesha ingqondo zakhelwe ngesivinini, amaphuzu, izinsuku ezilandelanayo namazinga. Kumuntu ophila nesifo sokukhohlwa lokho kungafana nomhlolo angeke amdlulele. Thina senze okuphambene, futhi sizibophezela kulezi mithetho:

  • Akukho okuzokwehluleka kukho. Akukho sikhathi, amaphuzu, inani lokunyakaza, izimpilo, izinsuku ezilandelanayo, amaqhinga noma ukubalwa okusheshayo kunoma iyiphi iskrini.
  • Ukubona kungaphezu kokukhumbula. Izithombe zihlala zibonakala ngokuzenzakalelayo. Izikhuthazo zimemezela ingxoxo futhi azikaze zibuze amagama noma izinkumbulo.
  • Kukhulu, kulula futhi kuzinzile. Umbhalo nezithombe ezinkulu, ukukhanyiselwa okunamandla, nezilawuli ezihlala endaweni efanayo.
  • Inhlonipho yabantu abadala. Izithombe zempilo yansuku zonke namazwi acacile nafudumele. Hhayi izithombe zamakhathuni, izibongo ezinomculo wezingane noma imivuzo yezimemezelo.
  • Indlela yokuphuma kalula. “Ngiyeke okwamanje” ihlala ibonakala. Ukuyeka phakathi kuyisiphetho esihle.
  • Imfihlo njengesimo esijwayelekile. Akukhoma-akhawunti noma izikhangiso. Izithombe ozikhethayo zihlala kudivayisi yakho.

Esingakubangeli

Imidlalo yethu ikhona ukujabula nokuxhumana. Ayixilongi, ayihloli, ayilinganisi, ayelapheli, ayinciphisi noma ayivimbeli isifo sokukhohlwa noma isifo sika-Alzheimer’s, futhi akekho kufanele ayikhethe ngalesi sizathu. Lapho sibhala ngocwaningo emakhasini ethu wempilo yengqondo, sithi ngokusobala ukuthi ubufakazi buthambile, futhi asisoze siluhlanganise nemidlalo yethu.

Thina ngubani

I-Golden Moments yiqembu elincane elizimele. Asiyona izazi zezokwelapha. Imihlahlandlela yethu ibhalwe ngokusekelwe kwezeluleko ezishicilelwe yizinhlangano ezifana ne-National Institute on Aging kanye ne-Alzheimer’s Association, futhi yonke imihlahlandlela ibala imithombo yayo. Funda ukuthi sibhala futhi sihlola kanjani amakhasi ethu.

Sitshele okusiza

Sizothokoza ukuzwa ukuthi yini esebenza kini nokuthi yini engasebenzi, ikakhulu kubantu abaphila nesifo sokukhohlwa, kubanakekeli bemindeni nakubasebenzi bemisebenzi. Thumelani i-imeyili ku-{email}.

editorial.title: Indlela Esibhala Ngayo Futhi Esihlola Ngayo Amakhasi Ethu
editorial.description: Indlela i-Golden Moments ecwaninga, ebhala, ekhomba imithombo futhi ebuyekeza ngayo amakhasi ayo emisebenzi yesifo sokukhohlwa nempilo yengqondo, nokuthi yini esingeke sayishicilela.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Imithombo yethu

Sisekela imihlahlandlela yethu ezeluleko zoluntu ezivela ezinhlanganweni ezifana ne-National Institute on Aging, i-CDC, i-Alzheimer’s Association, i-Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, i-Family Caregiver Alliance kanye ne-NHS, nasocwaningweni olubuyekezwe izazi, olufana nokubuyekezwa kwe-Cochrane nezivivinyo ezinkulu zezokwelapha. Yonke imihlahlandlela ibala imithombo eyisekelayo. Sivula ngayinye imithombo ngaphambi kokuyibala, futhi sibika kuphela lokho ethi ngempela.

Indlela esibhala ngayo

  • Okusebenzayo kuqala: okufanele kwenziwe namuhla, ngolimi olulula.
  • Iqiniso ngobufakazi: sithi “kuhlobene na”, “kungenzeka” kanye “ubufakazi buhlukahlukene” lapho kuyiqiniso.
  • Inhlonipho: sibhala ngabantu abaphila nesifo sokukhohlwa njengabantu abadala, futhi asisoze sisebenzise ulimi lokubuza noma lokuhlazisa.
  • Akukho okwenziwe ngamanga: akukho izibalo, amazwi, izazi, izifundo, ukubuyekezwa noma izitatimende zabantu ezenziwe.

Ababuyekeza amakhasi ethu

Amakhasi abhalwa futhi ahlolwa yiqembu le-Golden Moments, lisizwa amathuluzi okubhala ngokusebenzisa i-AI ocwaningweni nasekubhaleni kwesisho. Yonke ikhasi lihlolwa yiqembu ngokulinganisa nemithombo yalo. Amakhasi ethu awazange abuyekezwe udokotela noma omunye umsebenzi wezokwelapha, futhi asiqinisekisi okunye. Ayikho imininingwane yezokwelapha, kodwa ngolwazi jikelele, hhayi iseluleko sezokwelapha.

Esingeke sikushicilele

  • Izitatimende zokuthi umdlalo, ukudla, umkhiqizo wokwengezela, ukuzila noma uhlelo lwansuku zonke kuvimbela, kwelapha, kunciphisa noma kuqeda isifo sokukhohlwa.
  • Izivivinyo, imibuzo noma amaphuzu angase akhombise ukuthi umuntu unesifo sokukhohlwa, noma akanaso.
  • Iseluleko sokuqala, ukuyeka noma ukushintsha noma yimuphi umuthi.
  • Izikhangiso noma okuqukethwe okuthengiswayo okufihlwe njengeseluleko.

Izibuyekezo nokulungisa

Ikhasi ngalinye libonisa usuku lokubuyekezwa kwalo lokugcina. Uma uthola iphutha noma umthombo osuphelelwe yisikhathi, sicela uthumele i-imeyili ku-{email} sizohlola masinyane.

faq.title: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo
faq.seoTitle: Imidlalo Nemisebenzi Yesifo Sokukhohlwa: Imibuzo Nezimpendulo
faq.description: Izimpendulo ezilula zemibuzo evamile ngemidlalo nemisebenzi yesifo sokukhohlwa: yimiphi imidlalo ongayizama, ukudlala isikhathi esingakanani, imibono yesigaba sokugcina, impilo yengqondo nemfihlo.
faq.lede: Izimpendulo ezimfishane nezicacile emibuzweni abanakekeli abayibuza kakhulu.

items.q: Yimiphi imidlalo engcono kumuntu ophila nesifo sokukhohlwa?
items.a: Imidlalo engcono ijwayelekile, ilula futhi ayinacindezelo, futhi eyilungileyo iwukuthi umuntu uyithanda namuhla. Ukuhlanganisa izithombe ezibonakalayo, ukuhlela, ama-jigsaw alula, ukuqeda izaga ezijwayelekile, ukudweba nokudlala i-bingo yezithombe kusebenza kahle kubantu abaningi. Gwema izikhathi, amaphuzu nanoma yini ezwakala njengevivinyo.
Yebo. Yonke imidlalo lezinto zokuprinta zitholakala mahala, kungeladingeko le-akhawunti, ukubhalisa, ukudawuniloda kumbe izikhangiso.

items.q: Kungani kungelamanqaku, izigaba kumbe iwashi elibalayo?
items.a: Ukuphangisa kanye lamanqaku kuguqula umsebenzi othokozisayo ube njengomhloli, okungadala inhloni kumbe ukukhathazeka. Sibeka umqondo ekuthokozeni lasekuchitheni isikhathi ndawonye, ngakho akukho okokuhluleka njalo lingamisa loba nini.

items.q: Yiziphi izinto zobuchwepheshe ezisebenza kahle kakhulu?
items.a: Loba yiwuphi umakhalekhukhwini, ithebulethi kumbe ikhompuyutha elesiphequluli sewebhu sanamuhla. Ithebulethi esesisekelweni sayo etafuleni ivame ukuba yindlela ekhululekileyo yokuthi abantu ababili badlale behlezi eceleni komunye. Ikhompuyutha ephathekayo exhunywe kuthelevitshini isebenza kahle kakhulu kumaqembu.
Yebo. Umdlalo we-Photo pairs uguqula izithombe ezi-2 kusiya ku-6 ozikhethayo zibe ngumdlalo wokufanisa. Izithombe zisala kusiphequluli sakho njalo azifakwa ku-inthanethi kumbe ukugcinwa.

Kujwayelekile ukuthi imizuzu elitshumi kusiya kwengamatshumi amabili yanele, kanti kwesinye isikhathi imizuzu emibili nje iyingxenye yempumelelo. Qaphelani izimpawu zokudinwa kumbe ukucaphuka, lilise lapho kusathe ntwala ukuthokoza. Akukho sikhathi esibekiweyo esifaneleyo.

Hloniphani ukwala kwabo, lizame njalo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kumbe ngenye indlela. Ukwala kungenzeka kudalwe yikudinwa, ubuhlungu, ukungaqiniseki kumbe ukungabi lentando nje. Bonani isiqondiso sethu esimayelana lalokho okwenziwayo nxa besala.

items.q: Yimiphi imisebenzi efanela isigaba esiphezulu sokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo?
items.a: Ukuthula lezinzwa: ukulalela umculo othandekayo, ukuhlikihla izandla ngamafutha athambileyo, ukubukela izithombe ndawonye, ukugona ingubo ethambileyo, ukuhlala phandle, kumbe umdlalo olula kakhulu wezithombe umuntu ehlezi eceleni kwabo. Isiqondiso sethu sesigaba esiphezulu silamacebo amanengi kakhulu.

items.q: Ikhona yini imisebenzi yamaqembu ezindlini zabanakekelwa?
items.a: Yebo. I-Picture bingo ilamakhadi angaphrintwa kanye lomemezeli osekrini, kanti i-Finish the saying lamakhadi e-Conversation cards asebenza kahle nxa ebalwa ngokuzwakalayo. Isiqondiso sethu samaqembu ezindlini zabanakekelwa sichasisa ngobukhulu beqembu, ukuhlalisana kanye lokulungiselela abantu abalamandla angafananiyo.

items.q: Imidlalo ingavikela kumbe yehlise ukuhamba kokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo?
items.a: Akulamdlalo oke watshengisa ukuthi uyavikela ukulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, njalo lemidlalo yethu ayitsho njalo. Ukuvuselela ingqondo emphakathini kuke kwatshengisa inzuzo encane ocwaningweni lwabantu abaphila lokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo okuncane kusiya phakathi, kodwa lokho kwehlukile ekutheni umdlalo unqande umkhuhlane. Sinikela imidlalo ngenxa yokuthokoza lokwakha ubudlelwano.

Hatshi ngokuqiniseka. Ucwaningo luhlanganisa izinto ezi-14 zempilakahle lendlela yokuphila lengozi yokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, ezifana lokungezwa ezindlebeni, umfutho ophezulu wegazi, ukungawuvocavoci umzimba kanye lokuhlala wedwa ungekho labanye. Ukuzilungisa kungenzeka kwehlise ingozi kwabanye abantu, kodwa abantu abanengi abenza konke okulungileyo balokhu behlaselwa yikulahlekelwa yinkumbulo. Akusiso iphutha lomuntu loba nini.

items.q: Ukuzila ukudla ngezikhathi ezithile kulungele impilakahle yengqondo yini?
items.a: Ubufakazi obusebantwini bucuthekile njalo kusesekuqaleni, kanti ucwaningo olunengi lwenziwe ezinyameni. Ukuzila ukudla kungaba lengozi kwabadala, ikakhulu nxa kuthathwa imithi yesifo seshukela kumbe ukuhla komzimba okungaqondwanga, njalo akukhuthazwa kubantu abaphila lokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo. Khulumani lodokotela lingakaguquli indlela elidla ngayo.

Akulamakhawunti kumbe izikhangiso. Sisebenzisa i-Google Analytics ukubala abavakatsheli lokubona ukuthi ngamaphi amakhasi ancedayo, kanti isiphequluli sakho siyakhumbula ukuthi uvulile yini imisindo ethambileyo. Izithombe ozikhethela i-Photo pairs azilokothi zifakwe ku-inthanethi. Bonani isaziso semfihlo ukuze lithole imininingwane.
Hatshi. I-Golden Moments ngeyokuzilibazisa kanye lemininingwane ejwayelekileyo. Emibuzweni yezempilakahle, khulumani lodokotela, kanti nxa kulesimo esiphuthumayo fonelani u-999.

faq.moreHtml: Imininingwane eyengeziweyo: ukudlala ndawonye, lapho besala, imisebenzi yesigaba esiphezulu kanye lokuthi ukulahlekelwa yinkumbulo kungavinjelwa yini?

handout.title: Imidlalo Yamahala, Ethambileyo Yabantu Abaphila Lokulahlekelwa Yinkumbulo
handout.seoTitle: Iphepha Eliprintwayo: Imidlalo Yamahala Yokulahlekelwa Yinkumbulo Ku-inthanethi
handout.description: Iphepha elilodwa eliprintwayo lemuli labanakekeli elimayelana lemidlalo yezithombe yamahala lethambileyo yabantu abaphila lokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, elenzelwe amaqembu osekelo lezikhwama zosizo.
handout.lede: Printani leli khasi ngenxa yeqembu losekelo, iphakethe lokunakekela kumbe esivalweni sefriji. Sebenzisani umyalo wokugcinda wesiphequluli senu; amamenyu lamabhathini akukhutshwa ekhasini eliprintwayo.
handout.introHtml: Izithombe ezinkulu, amagama alula njalo akukho okokuhluleka. Mahala efonini, ethebulethini kumbe kukhompuyutha, kungelakubhalisa, kungelazikhangiso, kungelamawashi abalayo njalo kungelamanqaku. Hlalani eceleni komunye liyekelane amathuba.
handout.restHtml:
Amacebiso ambalwa

  • Khethani isikhathi sosuku lapho umuntu azizwa ehloniphekile kumbe enamile kakhulu khona.
  • Qalisani ngesilungiselelo esilula kakhulu. Izikwele ezine zanele kakhulu.
  • Xoxani ngezithombe. Ingxoxo iyona evame ukuba yingxenye enhle kakhulu.
  • Phelisani lapho kusathokozisa. Ukuphetha masinya kungumphumela omuhle.

Okunye okukuwebhusayithi

  • Izinto zokuprinta zamahala: ukucinga amagama ngamabala amakhulu, amakhasi okufaka imibala, amakhadi engxoxo kanye le-picture bingo.
  • Amacebo emisebenzi yezigaba zonke, kanye leziqondiso zokudlala ndawonye kanye lokuzinakekela.

Okwokuthokoza kanye lokuchitha isikhathi ndawonye. Akusiso iseluleko sezokwelapha, ukuhlolwa kumbe ukwelatshwa. I-Golden Moments ishicilelwe yi-Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.seoTitle: Imisebenzi Yamahala Yabantu Abaphila Lokulahlekelwa Yinkumbulo Yezindlu Zabagugileyo Lamaqembu
organizations.description: Indlela izindlu zabagugileyo, izinhlelo zokunakekela abadala emini, izindlu zamabhuku, inhlanganiso ezisekela abagugileyo lamaqembu okusekelana abasebenzisa ngayo imidlalo yethu yamahala yabantu abaphila lokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, kanye lamazwi okusifaka ohlwini lwezinsiza.
organizations.lede: Konke okukulikheli lewebhusayithi kumahhala ukukusebenzisa labahlali, amalunga labantu elibasebenzelayo, kungela akhawunti, ilayisensi kumbe imali ebhadelwayo. Likhasi lichaza okutholakala lapha lendlela yokukwabelana labanye.
organizations.shortText: {name}: imidlalo yemifanekiso epholileyo yamahala leziqondiso zemisebenzi yokuzilibazisa yabantu abaphila lokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo lababanakekelayo. Akudingi ukubhalisa, akulamawotshi abala isikhathi, njalo akulamaphuzu.
organizations.longText: {name} ({domain}) ipha imidlalo engu-{count} yamahala yebhrawuza eyenzelwe abantu abaphila lokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, kuhlanganisa ukutshayanisa imifanekiso efanayo lapho imifanekiso esala ibonakala, iphazili elula, ukuhlela, izaga ezijwayelekileyo le-bingo yemifanekiso enamakhadi angaprintwa. Akudingi akhawunti, izikhangiso, iwotshi elibala isikhathi kumbe amaphuzu. Iwebhusayithi ilazo njalo iziqondiso ezilotshwe ngolimi olulula zesigaba ngasinye sokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo ezicaphuna ulwazi oluvela ku-National Institute on Aging le-Alzheimer's Association.
organizations.gamesItemHtml: Imidlalo engu-{count} yebhrawuza esebenza kukhompuyutha ephathwayo, ithebhulethe kumbe kumabonakude oxhunywe kukhompuyutha. Akudingi ukuyifaka ohlelweni, akhawunti kumbe ukuyidawuniloda. Bona yonke imidlalo.
organizations.printablesAfter: Sebenzisa inkinobho ethi Print ekhasini ngalinye.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Izinhlelo zamaqembu: I-bingo yemifanekiso ilamakhadi angaprintwa lommemezeli osesikrinini, kanti imibuzo elula yolwazi ilemibuzo engu-50 elokukhetha kwezimpendulo lezihloko zokuxoxa.
  • Iziqondiso zemisebenzi yokuzilibazisa zabasebenzi lezimuli, ngokwezigaba langokwezinhlobo, ezilotshwe ngolimi olulula zilamaphepha acaphuniweyo. Qala nge-mbono engu-101 yemisebenzi yokwenza kumbe imisebenzi yamaqembu yezindlu zabagugileyo.
organizations.restHtml:
Indlela amaqembu akusebenzisa ngayo

  • Izindlu zabagugileyo lezindawo zokunakekela inkumbulo: i-bingo yemifanekiso kumbe ukuqedelela izaga kumabonakude wekamelo lokuhlala, lapho umuntu oyedwa eqofa esikrinini emela iqembu.
  • Izinhlelo zabadala zasemini: indawo yethebhulethe ele-Picture pairs ehlelwe yamathayela amane, eyenzelwe izikhathi ezimfushane zomuntu lomuntu.
  • Izindlu zamabhuku zomphakathi: ukudinga amagama okuprintiweyo lamakhadi okuxoxa ezikhwameni zenkumbulo, kanye lewebhusayithi efakwe kumabhukhmakhi kumathebhulethe endlu yamabhuku.
  • Amaqembu okusekelana kwabanakekeli lama-memory café: ipheshana elilodwa eliprintwayo elenzelwe izimuli ukuthi zihambe lalo ekhaya.
  • Izibhedlela labahlela ukugoduka kwabantu: ipheshana elisezikhwameni zabanakekeli, elenzelwe okuthile okuzolileyo okungenziwa ekhaya kumbe eceleni kombhede.

Esingakwenziyo

Imidlalo le yenzelwe ukuthokozisa lokuchitha isikhathi ndawonye. Ayihloli ukugula, ayivivinye, ayiniki amaphuzu, ayelaphi kumbe ukunciphisa ukuhamba phambili kokulahlekelwa yinkumbulo, njalo sicela izinhlanganiso ukuthi zingayichazi ngaleyondlela. Akulazikhangiso, kanti lemidlalo ayiceli amabizo, imininingwane yezempilakahle kumbe ukuthi kukhwezwe imifanekiso. Iwebhusayithi isebenzisa i-Google Analytics ukubala abavakatshela kuyo; isaziso sethu sobumfihlo sichaza lokho ekubuthayo. Imifanekiso esetshenziswa ku-Photo pairs isala kubhrawuza kuphela.

Sifake ohlwini lwakho lwezinsiza

Uba ulelohlu lwezinsiza zabanakekeli, wamukelekile ukufaka isixhumanisi esiya ku-{domain}. Ungakopela incazelo ngayinye kwezimbili lezi.
organizations.linksHtml:
Amakhasi aqakathekileyo ongawaxhuma ngqo: imidlalo yamahala, izinto eziprintwayo zamahala, imisebenzi ye-Alzheimer's kanye lokuthi ingadlalwa njani ndawonye.

Imibuzo kumbe ukulungisa amaphutha

Uba kukhona okungaqondanga kumbe okungazwakaliko kulewebhusayithi, kumbe izidingo zomhlali zingasuthiswa yilokho okutholakala lapha, sicela usazise ku-{email}. Sicela ungasithumeli imininingwane eqondene lomuntu kumbe eyempilakahle yabahlali loba abantu elibasebenzelayo.

app.title: I-App ye-Golden Moments
app.description: I-app yamahala ye-Golden Moments: ukufanisa imifanekiso okuthambileyo ngamathayela amane amakhulu, imifanekiso yemuli egcinwa kudivayisi yakho, izinqwaba zemifanekiso ezisebenza ingekho i-inthanethi njalo kungela akhawunti.
app.lede: Konke okuthandayo ngewebhusayithi, phakathi kwe-app esebenza ingekho i-inthanethi njalo engasebenzisa imifanekiso yemuli oyikhethayo.
app.bodyHtml:
Qalani ngokuncane

Qalani ngamakhasi amane amakhulu lemifanekiso eyaziwayo. Yekelani imifanekiso ibonakale, loba liyifihle nxa libona kufanele. Indlela elula kayilaso isikhathi esibalwayo, amamaki loba inhlawulo. Khethani amakhasi angu-4, 6, 8 loba 12.

Kwenzeni okwasekhaya

Khethani izithombe zemuli lisebenzisa isikhethi sezithombe sedivayisi yenu. Uhlelo lolu lubeka amakhophi amancane emisebenzi yalo. Kaluhlolisisi yonke imifanekiso yenu loba luntshintshe izithombe zenu zakuqala, njalo lugcina izithombe ezingafika ku-24 eqoqweni linye.

Khangelani ndawonye nje

Bukani umfanekiso owodwa ngesikhathi. Imibuzo ongayikhetha iqalisa ingxoxo ngaphandle kokubophezela umuntu ukuthi akhumbule amabizo loba aphendule ngokuqondileyo. Ukubuka nje kwanele.

Kusebenza lanxa kungekho intanethi

Imifanekiso yokuqala kanye lezixha zonke eziyisificaminwembili zifakwe phakathi kohlelo lolu. Amakhophi ezithombe afakiweyo ayasebenza ngaphandle kwentanethi. Ukukhetha izithombe zakuqala ezigcinwe ku-iCloud kuphela kungadinga intanethi.

Akula-akhawunti, akulamaseva okuvumelanisa izithombe

Amakhophi ezithombe zemuli asala phakathi kohlelo kudivayisi yenu. Lingasusa amakhophi la ngaphandle kokucima izithombe zenu zakuqala. Ukubekela eceleni kwedivayisi kungafaka phakathi imininingwane yalolu hlelo. Balani inqubo yobumfihlo yohlelo, njalo usizo lohlelo luchasisa igxathu ngalinye.
app.disclaimer: I-Golden Moments yenzelwe ukuzithokozisa lengxoxo zokwabelana. Kayihloli, kayelaphi, kayivimbi njalo kayilinganisi umkhuhlane wokukhohlwa loba i-Alzheimer.

gamesIndex.title: Imidlalo Yamahala Ye-inthanethi Yabaphila Lokukhohlwa Le-Alzheimer
gamesIndex.description: Imidlalo yamahala ku-inthanethi yabantu abadala abaphila lomkhuhlane wokukhohlwa loba i-Alzheimer: ukutshayanisa imifanekiso, ama-jigsaw alula, ukuhlela, izitsho, ukufaka imibala, lebhingo. Akubhaliswa, kakusetshenziswa sikhathi njalo kakulamamaki.
gamesIndex.lede: Imidlalo engu-{count} yamahala yokudlala ndawonye kusiphequluli senu. Imifanekiso emikhulu, amazwi alula, njalo akula kwehluleka: akulasikhathi, akulamamaki, akubhaliswa.
gamesIndex.byStageLede: Izigaba ziyisiqondiso nje. Landelani lokho okuthokozisa umuntu omnakekelayo lalokho okumnandi kuye lamuhla.
gamesIndex.moreHtml: Eminye imicabango engaphandle kwesikrini: izinto zokwenza ezingu-101 zabantu abaphila lokukhohlwa, izinto zokwenza lemidlalo ye-Alzheimer, imidlalo elula yokukhumbula kanye lamaphazili.

faq.a: Ukutshayanisa imifanekiso ngamakhasi amane yikhetho lokuqala elithuleyo. Nxa ukukhetha phakathi kwemifanekiso kubonakala kunzima, lingazama okokuthi Thola okufanayo ngemifanekiso emibili. Eqoqweni labantu, zamani i-Picture bingo.

faq.q: Imidlalo le iyasebenza ku-iPad loba efonini?
faq.a: Yebo. Umdlalo ngamunye usebenza kusiphequluli kumafoni, kumathebulethi lakukhompyutha, njalo imifanekiso iyakhula ukugcwalisa isikrini. Ithebulethi ebekwe esisekelweni ivamise ukunethezisa kakhulu abantu ababili.

faq.q: Imidlalo le ilungele umuntu ophila le-Alzheimer na?
faq.a: Yebo. Yenzelwe abantu abaphila lomkhuhlane wokukhohlwa, okugoqela i-Alzheimer, okuyiyo ebangela kakhulu. Imifanekiso ihlala ibonakala, kulezinketho ezimbalwa kuphela, njalo akulamuntu obalelwa isikhathi loba amamaki, ngakho imidlalo le igxila ekuboneni izinto ezijwayelekileyo kulokukhumbula izinto ezintsha.

faq.q: Le yimidlalo yokukhumbula eyenzelwe abantu abadala na?
faq.a: Yimidlalo yokutshayanisa lemifanekiso engathokozelwa loba ngumuphi umuntu omdala, kodwa yakhelwe ukungahloli inkumbulo: ku-Picture pairs imifanekiso ihlala yembulekile ngaphandle nxa likhetha ngenye indlela. Isiqondiso sethu semidlalo yokukhumbula yabantu abadala abaphila lokukhohlwa siyachasisa ukuthi lingawenza njani loba ngowuphi umdlalo wokukhumbula ukuba ube lula.

faq.q: Ikhona yini imidlalo yamaqembu asemakhaya okunakekela?
faq.a: Yebo. I-Picture bingo ilamakhadi angaphrintwa lommemezeli osesikrinini, njalo i-Finish the saying le-Conversation cards zisebenza kuhle nxa zibalelwa phezulu eqenjini.

faq.q: Lukhona yini uhlelo lwezinto zokwenza lwabaphila lokukhohlwa?
faq.a: Yebo. Golden Moments (ebhalwe njenge "{storeName}") itholakala mahala ku-App Store le-Google Play. Ilohlelo olulula lokutshayanisa imifanekiso ngamakhasi amakhulu, imidlalo elezithombe zemuli elizikhethelayo, lezixha zemifanekiso ezisebenza ngaphandle kwentanethi.
Yebo. Lulula ukulidawuniloda mahala, kalulazikhangisi, i-akhawunti loba ukuthenga phakathi kohlelo.

faq.q: Uhlelo lolu luyasebenza yini ngaphandle kwentanethi?
faq.a: Yebo. Imifanekiso yokuqala kanye lezixha zonke eziyisificaminwembili zemifanekiso zifakwe phakathi kohlelo, njalo izithombe zemuli zisebenza ngaphandle kwentanethi lapho sezifakwe phakathi kohlelo. Ukukhetha isithombe esigcinwe ku-iCloud kuphela kungadinga intanethi.

Yebo. Khetha izithombe ngesikhethi sezithombe sedivayisi yakho. Uhlelo lugcina izikhopi ezincane kudivayisi ukuze lusebenzise emidlalweni yalo, aluzithumeli lapho, futhi aluzoze lushintshe izithombe zokuqala. Ungazisusa izikhopi nanini.

faq.q: Ingabe yi-app yokuqeqesha ingqondo noma yokuhlola inkumbulo?
faq.a: Cha. I-Golden Moments yokujabulisa nokuchitha isikhathi ndawonye. Ayinawo amaphuzu noma ukuhlolwa, futhi ayichazi, ayelaphi, ayivimbi noma ayilinganisi isifo sokulibala kwengqondo noma i-Alzheimer’s.

gameFaqYes.q: Ingabe kukhona inguqulo ye-app yalo mdlalo?
gameFaqYes.a: Yebo. I-app yamahhala ye-Golden Moments ye-iPhone, i-iPad ne-Android inokuhlanganisa izithombe okuthulile, ingasebenzisa izithombe zomndeni owukhethileyo, futhi isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Akudingeki i-akhawunti, azikho izikhangiso noma amaphuzu.

gameFaqNo.q: Ingabe kukhona inguqulo ye-app yalo mdlalo?
gameFaqNo.a: Cha,alo mdlalo awukho njengoba unjalo. I-app yamahhala ye-Golden Moments ye-iPhone, i-iPad ne-Android inokuhlanganisa izithombe okuthulile ngezithombe ezinkulu nezithombe zomndeni owukhethileyo, futhi isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Lo mdlalo uhlala mahhala lapha kusiphequluli sakho.
